summary: Build officerentdubai.com, a commercial property rental portal with a searchable/filterable listings frontend and an agent backend ("Agent Arena") to manage properties, including photos, with WhatsApp contact to a fixed number. Agent Arena access should be gated by an "Agent Code" entry (050702) instead of login/signup.
architectural_notes: Project is a commercial property rental portal with separate public frontend and agent backend ("Agent Arena").
WhatsApp contact should always redirect to +971 553723617.
Agent Arena authentication should be replaced by a simple Agent Code gate (code: 050702) to access add/edit listing features.
known_issues: Agent Arena backend: agents are currently unable to sign up and/or log in (authentication flow failing).

existing_features.title: Create the public frontend for OfficerRentDubai.com with a listings search section that includes: (1) a location text search bar, (2) a commercial type filter with exactly two options: Office and Retail, (3) an Area (SQFT) filter, (4) a Price filter, and (5) a Search action/button that applies the entered filters to the listings results.

Implement property listings browsing on the public frontend: display a results list/grid of properties and allow users to click a listing to open a dedicated listing details view/page showing full property details and photos.
Add a "Contact the agent" button on the listing details view that opens WhatsApp chat to the fixed number +971 553723617.

Implement Agent Arena authentication and access control for agent management features: provide login and signup capability for the agent area, and restrict property creation/editing/deletion to authenticated agents only.

Build the Agent Arena backend capabilities and corresponding frontend UI to add and manage properties, including capturing property details (at minimum: title, location, type: Office/Retail, area sqft, price, description) and uploading multiple photos per property.

Add one coherent, non-blue/non-purple visual theme for the entire app (public portal + Agent Arena) including consistent typography, color palette, spacing, and components styling appropriate for a premium commercial real-estate portal.
Add generated static image assets (logo and minimal UI illustrations/icons) and render them in the frontend from frontend/public/assets/generated (do not serve generated images through the backend).

Update the Agent Arena frontend flow to handle the backend’s “new user / no profile yet” state without getting stuck on loading or failing silently, and display a clear English error message when login/profile loading fails.

Replace the Agent Arena entry flow at route "/agent" to use an "Agent Code" gate instead of Internet Identity login/signup: show a single input for the agent code and a submit button; when the correct code "050702" is entered, persist the authorized state locally (e.g., localStorage) and navigate to "/agent/dashboard". All user-facing text must be in English.

Update route protection for all Agent Arena pages ("/agent/dashboard", "/agent/properties", "/agent/properties/new", "/agent/properties/edit/:id") to authorize access based on the locally-stored Agent Code authorization state (not Internet Identity identity/role). If unauthorized, show an "Access Denied" screen with a button/link back to "/agent".

Change the Agent Dashboard logout behavior to log out of the Agent Code session (clear the locally-stored authorization state and any related cached agent data) and then return the user to the Agent Arena entry page.

Update the frontend data layer so that create/update/delete property mutations always send the agent code to the backend, and display a clear English error message when the backend rejects an operation due to an invalid/missing agent code.

new_feature_requests.summary: Frontend: listings search with location bar, commercial type selector (office/retail), area (sqft) filter, price filter, and search action to run filters
Frontend: listing details page when a user clicks a listing, showing full property details and photos
Frontend: "Contact the agent" button that redirects to WhatsApp chat with +971 553723617
Backend "Agent Arena": add/manage property listings including property details and photo uploads

Create the backend canister (single Motoko actor) named/used by the frontend as “Agent Arena” that stores property listings and supports querying listings and listing details with filtering by location text, property type (Office/Retail), area (sqft), and price.
Align backend access control checks with the intended roles: property creation/editing/deletion must be restricted to authenticated agents, while public listing queries must remain public.
Replace Agent Arena login/signup with an "Agent Code" access gate: prompt for agent code (050702) and only allow backend add/edit listing features when the correct code is entered.

Enforce the Agent Code on the backend for all listing management operations: property creation, property update, and property deletion must require the correct agent code "050702"; public listing queries must remain publicly accessible without any agent code.
